It accepts the exactly bounded FC-01 early Line/Arrow, Triangle, Snap/Guide and minimum local History capabilities; every *unchanged* stage, Gate, old physical/source identity and successor G5/G6 condition in v0.1 is **incorporated without modification**. Semantic tuple Authority is separately scoped and Current at . **Notion Authority accepted; repository ****`.aegis/authorities.json`**** successor transition is PENDING and P31/P32 are NOT authorized.** ## 0. Authority topology / effective scope / history preservation - New `authority_id: fc-feature-completion-execution-v0.2`, `version: v0.2`, `kind: execution-policy`, `scope: execution:FC/feature-completion`, `status: Current (Notion P23)`, `supersedes: fc-feature-completion-execution-v0.1`, `depends_on: g4-capability-authority-v0.3` and FC-01 scoped where relevant. - Previously accepted FC-00 policy, original G4/PX0 history, source identity and FC13 PHYS/FCN DEV split remain effective. The old v0.1 historical page remains retrievable; it and its P10–P21 child design pages **are not deleted or rewritten**. When two interpretations differ only in FC-01/FC-06/FC-07 timing, **this new v0.2 is Current**. - Primary review/approval basis: and upstream / / / ; release entry ; overall Axiom G0–G9 Master Implementation Plan / Feature Completion Track Compass v0.2 — Current. - Correct exact developer source anchor remains `github:Mostorm-Labs/axiom@2942c63b375366ed977b834aa0a48fe2fb551c6e` (`codex/fc-00-fc-track-authority-p31`), not `main`, and not PX0 separate evidence-only branch. No automatic advancement of local branch HEAD is implied by this Notion P23. ## 1. Full FC task queue: only FC-01/06/07 early-slice amendments
Stage Effective v0.2 scope What remains for later owner / Gate
FC-00 Historical **closed for conditional development** with findings, accepted exact developer baseline `2942c63b…`; not reopened Original PX0/G4 physical/provider qualification remains outstanding

Basic FreePoint Straight Line/Arrow creation and hit moved earlier to FC-01 only. FC-06 retains all advanced Connector capability; no duplicated Line Shape; FC-01 basic slice has its own DEV gate

FC-13 Original-version PX0/G4.6/G4.7 and final integrated multi-platform PHYS campaign Exact original Gate P34 and held hosted provider refs remain independently required; no FC-13 retroactive waiver
**Inherited exact constraints:** all previous FC-00 v0.1 ordering/DEV Gate conditions (FC-01 → FC-01A → FC-02 … FC-12 → FC-13), FC-02/G6 boundary, FC-03/G4.7 resource boundary, FC-08 Frame/Section unresolved authority, FC-10 Clipboard ownership, G5 predecessor Gate requirements, original physical subject/build/version and hosted CI obligations are **not superseded**. The table restates task intent but is not authorization to skip any v0.1 prerequisite. ## 2. Accepted FC-01 DEV product slice (binding to FC-01 P14–P20) - User-defined five creation presets yield only existing two ObjectKinds: Shape/1 Rectangle/Ellipse, Shape/2 Triangle, Connector/1 FreePoint Line/Arrow. **No Line/Arrow ShapeKind** and no `SetShapeKind` or post-creation kind conversion. - For basic Line/Arrow, accept FC-01 **FreePoint/FreePoint Straight** create with a single InsertObjects and minimal Connector line/arrow hit/selection. Arrow has existing endDecoration=ARROW. No AttachedEndpoint, auto anchor, route algorithm, target snap-to-port or complex endpoint editing in FC-01. - For Snap/Guides, accept only FC-01 **creation/drag-time** center/edge far-axis candidate resolution against eligible visible objects (including remote perpendicular-axis distance), view logical-pixel tolerance and transient guide overlay. G4.6 owns base SnapResolver/SceneQuery presentation; FC-07 remains full align/distribute/layout owner. No Canonical guide/operation. - Accepted minimum selected-object commands: Fill/Stroke/Width/None/Opacity via existing PatchProperties, fixed-origin intrinsic size via SetObjectSize, transform handles via single SetTransforms, layer ordering via SetPlacements, locked/visible semantics and delete via existing Operations, Undo/Redo through existing History adapter only with safe preimages and current-state conflict guard. Text edit FC-02/05 and Copy/Cut/Paste/Duplicate FC-10 are disabled until separately accepted. - **Lock policy:** Frozen Field Registry already defines locked as persistent *editor-control* bool, not a global wire-parser or cross-client security enforcement. FC-01 product and Debug UI should prevent inappropriate manipulations on locked shapes, allow Unlock and truthful readback; semantic operation acceptance remains the current V1 policy. - **Resize policy:** handle-based resize = one SetTransforms with W/H unchanged, numeric ShapeContent W/H edit = one SetObjectSize with Transform unchanged. Atomic intrinsic resize+Transform relocation is **deferred**; do not fake with two Operations inside one undo item. - **Cross-version:** Shape/2 admission requires new feature/schema capability; unsupported old editable clients must fail closed when Triangle objects would be lost/changed. Snapshot v2 is necessary but not proof of feature support. No silent decode as Rectangle, downgrade or partial replay. ## 3. Per-stage verification and real-platform obligation preservation - FC-01 P14–P17 must prove one common Runtime Facade owner, correct typed tool/preset/effective-property readbacks, input capture/cancel/gesture arbitration, canonical create/undo, history receipt identity and provider-specific non-physical interface coverage. Debug UI is a client, not a SemanticStore owner. - FC-01 P20 must freeze an independent executable oracle for Triangle Shape/2 vs old V1 `SH-G06` rejection, Operation Envelope/Brush2 non-regression, Snapshot-v2/old-client refusal, replay/History, far-axis Snap, FreePoint Connector selection/hit and versioned Scene Render, each according to impact. P10–P13 seeds are not P20 accepted fixtures by themselves. - FC-N-DEV P34 can review verified deterministic/structural/build/host-bound behavior, **never** replace original PX0-07 P34 or G4.6-C/G4.7 physical/provider Gates. FC13 separately runs original pinned versions and final integration build. All 23 Windows and 23 Web PX0 required controls and G4.6-C 6×3 scenarios remain in FC-00 accepted debt records. - P31 requires **accepted exact repo-local successor Authority plus canonical Aegis v0.6 recompute / independent review**, a coherent frozen FC-01 P20, accepted P14–P17 contracts and content-addressed package; until then, **FC-01 P31/P32: BLOCKED / NOT_AUTHORIZED**. No P34, Gate or Integration history changes implied. ## 4. No-change clauses / successor obligations - Current G4.6/G4.7/PX0 original source, repo CI profiles, semantic ID1/2 meaning, G5 performance inputs and deferred FC-13 physical remain frozen. FC-01 source ancestry inherits FC-00 exact `2942c63b...` baseline and must not use separate PX0 evidence ref as code source. - Existing FC-06/07 owners do **not** lose their original scopes; only the explicitly enumerated minimal user-visible five-tool and far-axis creation slice is moved earlier. This is a **timing** change with independently reviewable FC-01-DEV oracles, not duplication of implementation owners. - Existing FC-10 owner keeps comprehensive history and Clipboard; minimum single-object FC-01 undo is a predecessor dependency, not completion of FC-10. - FC-01 P14–P17 and P20 are not executed by P23. No GitHub product source, Aegis gate/authority/result, Canonical V1 Registry, descriptor lock or Notion predecessor history was mutated by this new page. ## 5. The repo-local v0.6 Authority cache remains formally the old v0.1 until an independent controlled transition accepted before P31; this is a named consistency debt, not evidence of FC-01 code readiness.
